The signed orbit-conflict Lefschetz formula is correct because selecting any whole vertex cycle contributes -1 to the augmented Euler trace; reduced H8 is even, so trace is negative of the conflict independence polynomial at -1. Norm 720 gives irreducibility and sign twist S^(4,2); 9-dimensional involution of trace -1 has eigenspaces 4 and 5. This is exhaustive finite topology and character computation, not a general graph theorem.
